sourceRequest: 업무 한도 40건은 뭐냐? 이런거 제한 제거해버려
outcome: Remove the default project-wide 40-task quota from Slack ingress, owner control and employee delegation, then verify the production research worker can use the same policy without changing historical research receipts.

deliverables.description: Zero means no project-wide task quota; retain per-task turn and delegation-depth bounds
Real PostgreSQL tests past task 40, full suite and lint
Review and qualify app and research-capable worker images with preserved job pins and rollback receipts
Read back actual acceptance and Slack delivery of a new question in the affected thread

constraints: Preserve existing research job company commits, release registry and uncertain external-effect receipts
Do not replay previously rejected Slack messages
No credentials or Slack message bodies in evidence
Company evidence stays in this repository
workspace: Existing isolated qws attachment; historical Quant provenance is unchanged.
